summary: SiteDocument is a data entity representing a document associated with a site. It includes IDs for both the document and the site, and is used for data access within the HSPnet system.
purpose: To enable storage and retrieval of documents linked to specific sites for recordkeeping and management.
content_gaps: No business workflow or UI processing described; only entity and fields defined.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is a web UI page/control for welcoming staff administrators, providing last login info, and facilitating error/warning display. It includes site and discipline filtering, date selection, view refresh, and management of submitted employment applications within a grid.
purpose: To provide staff administrators with a dashboard view of employment applications, allow filtering by site/discipline/date, display errors and warnings, and facilitate navigation and interaction.

workflows.name: View Employment Applications
steps: Select Site and Discipline via dropdowns
Choose Start and End Dates with calendar controls
Click Refresh to update grid display
View applications in grid including name, email, site, dates, status

business_rules: Required fields for start and end dates
Date input validated by regular expressions
StartDate must not be after EndDate
validations: CustomValidator to ensure StartDate is not after EndDate
conditions: Show Withdrawn checkbox controls data inclusion
Filtering parameters set by dropdown and input controls
system_behavior: Page loads with default filtered data (last 3 months)
Shows errors and warnings in dedicated panels
Refresh button triggers data rebind/grid update
dependencies: Site and Discipline entities for filtering options
exceptions: Error and warning panels shown when validation or data issues occur

summary: ServiceCode is an entity representing categorized codes with descriptions and alternative names/notes, used in association with courses and timetables.
purpose: To manage and retrieve service code metadata for course and timetable options, supporting alternate language fields.
business_rules: If alt language mode is active, use NameAlt and NotesAlt
conditions: Alt language mode determines which fields are used
system_behavior: Service codes can be listed, filtered by course or timetable
Localization applies when alt language mode is active
dependencies: HSPnetSession for language and user context

summary: SiteProfileHistory records actions performed on site profiles, including action date, section, user action, affected fields, agency info, user details, and phone contacts. It supports alternate language fields and formatted representations for audit and UI display.
purpose: To track and display the history of changes made to site profiles, including who performed changes, what sections were affected, and audit trails for support and compliance.

workflows.name: Search and Display Site Profile History
steps: Call SiteProfileHistorySearch with SiteID, SessionAgencyID, UserSession
Bind returned history to UI grid for review

business_rules: Use alternate language fields if alt language is active
Display formatted user details for audit
calculations: Formatted name and tooltip generation for user details
conditions: Support team is flagged when ByUserID differs from ByOriginalUserID and not sysadmin
system_behavior: Grid displays site profile history records
dependencies: HSPnetSession for language and agency context

summary: EmailPopupDocument represents files displayed in email popups, supporting searching and deleting file records based on structured data strings.
purpose: To manage document files for email popups, enabling lookup and deletion of files and folders based on provided data.

workflows.name: Search and Delete Email Popup Documents
steps: Call Search with DataInfo string to retrieve document list
Call Delete with DataInfo and ID to remove file and folder

business_rules: Files are deleted only if file and folder are valid
No operation if DataInfo is empty
conditions: DataInfo string determines available documents and their paths
system_behavior: Document list generated from DataInfo input
File and folder deletion handled safely, with errors captured
dependencies: System.IO for file and folder operations
exceptions: Try/catch used to suppress deletion errors
content_gaps: UI integration not described; file format handling covered only in code.
